title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP08-prep0 — base-owned transition test bridge
goal: Make the base-owned manifest and tools tests valid across the canonical-V3 and thin-wrapper transition before production paths change.
acceptanceCriteria: The manifest negative control uses a genuinely missing workflow executable and still fails closed, while template and synthetic-test fork parity remain covered.
The tools test proves two consecutive canonical V3 Analyze runs are byte-reproducible in an isolated artifacts directory and never rewrites tracked analysis snapshots.
Both tests pass on Windows, IFX Validate remains unchanged, and only the consumed authorization record is deleted; no runner, policy, workflow or required-check behavior changes.
